content: अम्बष्ठः .²1 The offspring of a man of the Brāhmaṇa and a woman of the Vaiśya tribe; ब्राह्मणाद् वैश्यकन्यायामम्बष्ठो नाम जायते <ls>Ms. 10. 8</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">13. 15</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 91</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> also अम्बष्ठानां दार्विहोमिको ब्राह्मणः . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 8. 4. 2</ls>. (According to <ls>Ms. 10. 47</ls> the duty of an अम्बष्ठ is the curing of diseases; अम्बष्ठानां चिकित्सितम्). .²2 An elephant-driver. अपश्यत्कुवलयापीडं कृष्णोऽम्बष्ठप्रचोदितम् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 43. 2</ls>. (<ab>pl.</ab>) .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a country and its inhabitants (they seem to have occupied the country to the east of Tākṣaśilā, comprising the modern district of Lahore.) .{@-ष्ठा@} <ab>N.</ab> of several plants:-- .³({%a%}) गणिका, यूथिका (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>जुई</ns>); .³({%b%}) पाठा (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>पाहाडमूळ</ns>). .³({%c%}) चुक्रिका (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>चुका</ns>); .³({%d%}) another plant (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>अंबाडा</ns>). .{@-ष्ठा, -ष्ठी@} An Ambaṣṭha woman.
